name: CPI Food Inflation
description: The Consumer Food Price Index (CFPI) tracks year-on-year change in food prices within the CPI basket. It is the most volatile part of headline inflation and the most exposed to monsoon and harvest swings.
source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
releaseSchedule: Released monthly alongside headline CPI, around the 12th.

chart.title: Food inflation jumped in September
chart.subtitle: All-India CFPI (combined), year-on-year %. September is provisional.
